name: bothouse 人设与记忆
description: 让九问的智能体带上 bothouse 角色的人设和一本共享的记忆 wiki。

display_description.en: Every model call carries the bothouse role's persona and its shared memory wiki, so the agent keeps one character and remembers what the team wrote down.
display_description.zh: 调用模型时带上 bothouse 角色的人设和共享记忆 wiki：一个性格说话，记得团队写下的事。

quick_inputs.zh: 在记忆 wiki 里查一下我们上次定了什么
quick_inputs.en: Look up in the memory wiki what we decided last time

quick_inputs.zh: 把今天定下的事记进记忆 wiki
quick_inputs.en: Write what we decided today into the memory wiki

display_description.en: Puts the bothouse role's persona and memory wiki section into the system prompt before each model call.
display_description.zh: 每次调用模型前，把 bothouse 角色的人设和记忆 wiki 说明放进系统提示词。
